name: r2-dispatch-once-zone
_comment: Zone ids written by the one-time paths (dispatch, missed SKIP, late correction) for a zone id beyond 2^53.

steps.why: Zone 123456789012345699 (int64 ...699, a bound double ...696, a spelled literal ...700), and a decoy zone 123456789012345696 so that a write of the bound double passes the irrigation_events foreign key. A due ONCE schedule, a ONCE schedule past grace, and a late-corrected uncertain one, all in that zone.
